h: Davido reportedly caught on camera as a crew member mentions a $1.5m show offer at Zlatan's wedding
p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile's wedding reception shows a member of Davido's crew reportedly telling him about a $1.5 million show offer, worth about ₦2 billion. His cousin, who was filming, reminded him the camera was still rolling. The video has spread widely online.
more: Davido was among the high-profile guests at the Lagos event.
Fans are debating the figure online.
